inspiration: Fan OC Michihiko Mebori (All-Eyes/Gorgon).
name: Gorgon
description: Stops the motion of anything in the user's line of sight until they blink or release focus. Larger targets demand more strain and slip free sooner than smaller ones.

inspiration: Fan OC Hibiki Albrecht (Queen of Sound / Duchess Wave).
name: Sound Wave
description: Allows the user to perceive and control sound waves, altering pitch, volume, speed, and direction. They can mimic voices, mute nearby hearing, or strike with focused bursts. Must detect the sound; heavy noise and hearing strain are drawbacks.

inspiration: Fan OC Norika Yosei.
name: Fairy Dust
description: Generates glowing dust the user moves by telekinesis to lift small loads, trace paths, or scatter light. The mutation adds faint wings and short flight. Too light for serious direct combat but useful for support and rescue.

inspiration: Fan OC River Munroe / Lady Flashback (Memory Projector).
name: Memory Projector
description: On fingertip touch, pulls a target's memories and projects them as a hologram from the user's eyes for others to watch from that person's viewpoint. Resistant minds block or blur withheld scenes. The user is blind from reality and locked onto seeing the memories whenever the quirk is being used.

inspiration: Fan OC Juri Tatsumi (REPLAY).
name: Playback
description: On touch, rewinds a person or object's actions. The user feels whatever pain, emotion, or strain the target underwent in that span; rewound objects relay stored impact and stress instead.

inspiration: Fan OC Miya Sairin.
name: Water
description: Allows the user to generate and control water within range. The mass is drawn from their hydration; any volume they lose track of snaps back through the skin as stinging cold until it is recovered.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #095 Ctrl.
name: Ctrl
description: Within about ten meters, copies, pastes, or undoes small non-living actions by tracing C, V, or Z on their fingers toward the target. Cannot affect living things; undo reaches up to two minutes back.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #007 Future Scenario.
name: Future Scenario
description: Shows possible futures in any mirror. The user may step to a chosen place-time for up to five minutes, then return to the present. Must name the second precisely and stand where they wish to arrive; each jump costs heavy stamina.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #033 Cosmos.
name: Cosmos
description: Generates flowing cosmic dust and nebula-dense clouds the user can shape and propel. The particles are the same kind that gather before stars form and can be packed into far denser masses. Weakens in strong daylight.

inspiration: BlueCola101 My Hero Academia Custom Quirk List (Marker).
name: Marker
description: Turns the fingers into markers whose drawn lines and shapes become real matter once the ink dries. Simple forms are reliable; large or moving constructs demand focus and stamina.

inspiration: Amino MHA OCs — OC Quirk Ideas by CJs-cats (Tracker).
name: Tracker
description: Reveals a glowing trail along one chosen person's past route. Every trail looks the same until the user reaches the current end of that path; switching targets requires a new focus.

inspiration: Original concept.
name: Animate
description: On touch, awakens non-living objects with a face and will of their own. They may cooperate, refuse, or deceive, and remember what they witnessed while awake. All animated objects return inert when the user falls asleep.

inspiration: Fan OC Kiseki Kachi (Dark Matter).
name: Dark Matter
description: Reshapes the user's shadow into goopy weapons, animals, or tools within medium range. Prolonged sculpting dulls focus and invites intrusive, anxious thoughts until they rest.

inspiration: Fan OC Rikara Kayama.
name: Lattice
description: Rearranges nearby atoms into crystal structures the user imagines. Crystals must grow from a surface they are touching, and each patch remembers its last form—forcing a new design there shatters the old lattice into cutting shards.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #008 Puppeteer.
name: Puppeteer
description: Reveals marionette strings on up to two people in line of sight and moves their bodies like puppets within medium range. Strings snap if sight breaks or either target leaves range.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #022 Hypnos.
name: Hypnos
description: On touch, puts targets to sleep for up to fifteen minutes. Each extra touch the same day blurs the last few minutes they remember.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #065 Kinetic.
name: Kinetic
description: Absorbs kinetic impacts into a personal reserve and must vent them as focused hand beams within ten minutes. Without stored energy the quirk does nothing; overfilling forces painful discharges.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #023 Kitsune.
name: Kitsune
description: The user has fox-like traits. After touching an animal once, the user becomes that species—not another person's likeness. Frequent skin contact with humans dulls the fox traits and helps keep a mostly human face and build.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #064 Spinblade (Ghoulplayzs).
name: Spinblade
description: Arms can turn into spinning blade limbs that cut flesh and wood but not metal or brick. Extended spinning numbs the arms for hours afterward.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #014 Cnidarian Sting.
name: Cnidocyte
description: Jellyfish-like mutant flesh with a constant touch sting whose intensity the user chooses. Can eat certain toxins to lace the next contact with matching poison for a short window.

inspiration: Original concept (Abyss rewrite); renamed from Store.
name: Oubliette
description: The right palm opens an inward-spiraling void that swallows touched matter into a weightless pocket where time stalls; the left palm releases stored items in aimed bursts. Total mass is capped, living targets resist entry, and volatile matter such as flames or gases scorch the intake rim until vented—choosing exactly what comes out is unreliable.

inspiration: Quotev 功率 | MHA Quirk Ideas #015 Safety First.
name: Safety First
description: Allows the user to see danger as green, yellow, or red up to miles away. Strong alerts sting the temples.
